answer: Persistent Attention Ledger. Each identity must maintain a publicly verifiable history of sustained, time-stamped participation; privileges unlock only after continuous logged activity over a rolling window. Cloned identities restart the clock, so a sybil farm pays the full waiting cost per clone. Attacker costs scale linearly: one ivory badge tier requires sixty days of uninterrupted presence, one pearl tier another ninety. Any gap above threshold resets progress, and a violet flag freezes the account until review, making mass identity creation economically wasteful.
